Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • Have you been thinking of changing the shelves in your infrared sauna?
  • Are you looking to change the look of your sauna?
  • Find out how you can do that and so much more by reading more below.

InfraredSaunaParts is a supplier of infrared sauna parts for many saunas across the country. We are the leading supplier that we also supply to other countries. It’s been more than 15 years since we first started and we’ve gained many loyal customers through our business in the infrared sauna parts.

We offer various goods that an infrared sauna needs and we’re able to help your sauna from the ground up because we have anything and everything you need to start an infrared sauna business. If you know exactly what you need, we offer various selections of items that you’re sure to find the right thing your need for your sauna.

At InfraredSaunaParts, one of our most extensive items is our wood parts.

In an infrared sauna, the use of wood is common because concrete tiles is hazardous to the sauna users since it can trigger thermal shock due to the difference of temperature between the concrete and the temperature in the sauna. Wood parts are safer and offer a more esthetic look to your sauna.

We use high quality wood to produce our wood parts because when heated, wood can release oil and resin into the air that in turn can cause harmful allergy reaction in some users. This is why our shelves, housings, holders, floors, and walls are made of high quality hypoallergenic woods and we don’t coat them with any harmful chemicals or coatings. Furthermore, InfraredSaunaParts uses only wood from highly sustainable forests that are renewable, fast-growing and professionally managed.

Check out our wood parts catalogue to know what we can offer you with and which product will suit your sauna. Once you’ve made up your mind, why not call the number below and talk to us about how we can help your infrared sauna business.
